provenance.m3_preprocessing: Single-origin expanding-window split: train = all values except last H steps, test = last H steps. Horizons: yearly=6, quarterly=8, monthly=18. TSF files read with Latin-1 byte decode. Series shorter than horizon+1 skipped. AutoETS season_length: yearly=1, quarterly=4, monthly=12. Reported MASE uses training-slice seasonal-naive denominator (same as Rust harness).
